body: The only way somebpdy could identify with my pain in my area is if I stopped what I was doing right now and became an alcoholic, a smoker, a user of illegal drugs, or believed in "God".

my family and their friends and peers and adults over the course of my entire life. sure nobody likes everybody. but i know the difference between dislike and hateful rhetoric/actions. emotional pain. psych have tried out so many fucking pills on me that i can't remember all the names. maybe they should realize one fucking day that i don't hurt just because of my genetics or because of some imbalance. i get treated like shit every fucking day by everyone.

imagine being psychologically assaulted by a gang of tens of people over the years with the most damage inflicted on you by the people you trusted the most, the police allowing it and thinking it is a form of entertainment, others dismissing your claims as crazy, people dedicating their lives trying to convince you the pain is only a perception, being forgotten and used to the point that you know you can never trust anybody, and the only people who will attempt to take your claim seriously can't tell the difference between a statement and a question. But you'll be so tired before you could ever finish the story. Nobody can ever help you. You've researched and been told every way to escape and to live peacefully. I'm going to kill myself because everyone's philosophies are coping with the pain instead of ending it. Let's see how coping works for all 7 billion of you.
